text:
maria: heads-up — customer demo blocked, sample-app failing in json-mode. will paste logs.
aj: what does the error look like?
maria: validator rejects tool output. sometimes works locally, sometimes not. flaky.
kai: flaky how? different prompts or after retries?
maria: appears tied to auth retry path. log snippet: 
```
2026-03-20T14:02:11Z ERROR validator: failed to parse tool output: json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)\nraw_body: "{\"action\": \"apply_patch\", \"patch\": \"@@\n-foo\n+bar,\"}"\n```
ellie: looks double-encoded (string containing JSON) AND model left a trailing comma in the patch field. two issues.
aj: double-encoded smells like our retry shim doing JSON.stringify before re-sending. we had a JS vs Py parity difference here before.
kai: confirm: when auth fails, we re-run the low-level tool call. the JS helper was passing serialized body to the transport on retry while Py passed the object. tests missed it because mocks normalized types.
maria: repro steps for devs:
```
# start sample app in dev mode
ENV=dev DEBUG=devex:tooling node sample-app/index.js
# trigger run, use an invalid token to force 401 then allow retry
curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/run -H "Authorization: Bearer bad-token" -d @prompt.json
```
ellie: quick mitigation: patch the retry wrapper to preserve the original toolArgs shape (don't stringify). add a small sanitizer that strips trailing commas as a last-resort heuristic. behind feature flag.
aj: i'll file a PR for the JS SDK to keep the shape intact and add unit tests that exercise the retry code path. will also add a changelog note. ETA EOD.
kai: i'll add a parity integration test (js + py) that simulates a 401 gateway then ensures the eventual tool invocation payload is an object and identical across retries. also assert transport mode (streaming vs non-streaming) is preserved.
maria: also add middleware in sample-app that logs raw incoming body on schema validation failure so customers get a clear error message. put note in README.
ellie: for the sanitizer: implement tiny regex to remove trailing commas at end of objects/arrays before parsing; toggle via env var SANITIZE_TOOL_OUTPUT. mark as heuristic in docs.
aj: minor gotcha: some downstream code expects preserved whitespace in model output for diffs; sanitizer should only run when parse fails, not as default. add to PR checklist.
maria: created issue DEVEX-4723: "sample-app: json-mode double-encode on auth-retry + trailing-comma sanitizer" with repro and proposed fixes. link in thread.
devrel-bot: issue DEVEX-4723 created by maria — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEVEX-4723
aj: PR up in a bit, ping me for hot review. i'll include unit + integration tests. :thumbsup: 
kai: i'll run some fuzz prompts to see how often model emits trailing commas; if high, escalate to model/regression.
ellie: thanks team — good catch. keeping sanitizer behind flag and preserving shape should unblock the demo and avoid masking real model bugs.
maria: closing loop: after patch + tests we should run the onboarding smoke suite against sample-app and the JS SDK in json-mode to prevent regressions.
